operating_notes.text: Mercedes-Benz agency model: cars sold on MBIL's behalf where only commission is recognised were ₹1,642.6 Cr in FY26 vs ₹1,426.5 Cr in FY25.
FY26 exceptional items of ₹3.58 Cr included ₹1.66 Cr on discarding property at non-viable Volkswagen outlets in Delhi and Haryana and workshop relocation.
Landmark Cars (East) Private Limited became a wholly owned subsidiary after acquiring the remaining 17% for ₹14.17 Cr w.e.f. October 06, 2025.
EVs contributed ~30% of new car sales in Q1FY27
After-sales revenue from EVs is 45-9% higher than ICE per car
New revenue stream from ChargeZone® partnership
Recorded highest-ever quarterly and half-yearly proforma total revenue in Q2FY27.
JSW Motors is an independent automotive brand distinct from JSW MG Motor India.
JSW Motors is setting up a new energy vehicle manufacturing plant at Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar.
Landmark plans to open 2 showrooms and 1 workshop in South Ahmedabad, and 1 showroom and 1 workshop in Bhopal for JSW Motors.

timeline.summary: Landmark Cars Limited schedules earnings conference call on May 27, 2026, at 10:00 AM (IST) with **Mr. Sanjay Thakker, Promoter, Chairman and Executive Director**, **Mr. Aryaman Thakker, Executive Director**, and **Mr. Surendra Agarwal, Chief Financial Officer** to discuss Q4FY26 audited results.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,278.52 Cr (+17.2% YoY), net profit ₹15.03 Cr (+758.9% YoY).

Landmark Cars Limited’s officials, including **Amol Arvind Raje**, will attend an **Incred Capital**-hosted virtual investor conference on **June 5, 2026, at 3:00 PM**, discussing publicly available information.
Landmark Cars applied to BSE and NSE on May 30, 2026, for the reclassification of promoter-group member Ms. Spruha Satish Mehta (holding nil shares) to the public category.
Landmark Cars reported Q1FY27 results with record revenue and PAT, highlighted EV growth and new model launches
Landmark Cars Limited’s officials, including **Amol Arvind Raje**, will hold a virtual analyst/institutional investor meet on **October 16, 2026, at 4:00 PM**, hosted by Motilal Oswal.
Landmark Cars reported Q2FY27 proforma total revenue of ₹1,943 Cr, up 17.26% YoY, driven by outlet ramp-up.
Landmark Cars Limited officials will meet investors on October 20, 2026 in Mumbai for a group meeting.
Landmark Cars Limited rescheduled Investors/Analysts Meet from October 20 to October 21, 2026, at 10:00 AM IST in Mumbai under Amol Arvind Raje (Mem. No.: A19459).
Landmark Cars signed letters of intent with JSW Motors to open five new outlets in Ahmedabad and Bhopal for its new passenger car brand.
